changelog:
- Initial release of dwnldr: download videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X/Twitter, Reddit, and 1000+ sites.
- Auto-detects supported video URLs and downloads immediately—no confirmation needed.
- Strips all metadata from downloaded files for privacy.
- Supports MP4 (best quality), MP3, playlists, and thumbnail extraction.
- Handles large files via LocalSend if too big for Telegram.
- Provides quick action buttons for repeat downloads, LocalSend, and file deletion.
